Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: premium real estate homepage service card illustration, a standalone transparent raster asset.
Primary request: an exquisitely detailed architectural dollhouse cutaway of a contemporary lived-in apartment, created as a photorealistic architectural presentation model with convincing tactile surfaces, far beyond a simplistic toy house.
Subject: a coherent open living room and kitchen, a bedroom partly visible behind a partition, natural oak plank flooring with varied grain, warm ivory textured linen sofa with soft cushions, one muted slate-blue upholstered accent chair, carefully fitted oak kitchen joinery and a pale natural stone counter, a few green indoor plants, clear glazed windows with slim frames. Restrained objects, no clutter. Clearly believable room proportions and circulation.
Composition/framing: elevated three-quarter FRONT viewpoint, visibly three-dimensional, roof removed and front walls cleanly cut away. An attractive approximately rectangular apartment on a slim architectural base. Complete object fully visible, no clipping; compact silhouette with roughly 8% clear transparent margin around all outer edges. Landscape 4:3 composition, model fills most of the image. Intended to display at about 340 by 260 CSS pixels in the lower-right part of a light homepage service panel.
Style/medium: premium photorealistic architectural CGI with tactile editorial realism, finely resolved fabric weave, oak grain, subtle plaster texture and believable glass; no toy-like simplification or plastic sheen.
Lighting/mood: diffuse upper-left daylight studio lighting, delicate natural contact shadows and subtle ambient occlusion, airy calm refined mood.
Color palette: warm ivory, soft oak, light natural stone, graphite window details, one quiet cool blue chair accent, restrained organic greens.
Scene/backdrop: TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background outside the apartment object, absolutely no opaque background, floor or studio sweep; preserve a very subtle semitransparent contact shadow for integration onto a very pale sage off-white webpage (#f0f3ed).
Constraints: no humans, no typography, no words, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks; no keys; no giant geometric primitives; no cartoon style; no opaque background.
